name: Titanium.Contacts
summary: The top-level Contacts module, used for accessing and modifying the system contacts address book.
description:
See examples for more information.

#### iOS Platform Notes

On iOS, the contacts database may be modified by an external application, causing any `Person` or
`Group` objects you've retrieved to be out of sync with the database. The IDs of these objects are
not guaranteed to remain the same, so updating an object when it is out of sync may have
unpredictable results.

To avoid this, listen for the [reload](api:Titanium.Contacts#reload) event. When you receive a
`reload` event, you should assume that any existing `Person` or `Group` objects are invalid and
reload them from the `Contacts` module before modifying them.

See the examples for a sample use of the `reload` event.

If 'ABAddressBookErrorDomain error 0' occurs, it implies that you are not allowed to add or edit
certain fields. Check your default account in the iOS settings under contacts. If it's not 'iCloud',
most likely it will not support fields such as alternateBirthday or socialProfile.

These APIs are unavailable on macOS if the app is built on a version of Xcode < 12.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_AUTHORIZED
properties.summary:
A [contactsAuthorization](api:Titanium.Contacts#contactsAuthorization) value
indicating that the application is authorized to use the address book.
properties.description: This value is always returned on Android devices, as well as on iOS versions earlier than 6.0.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_DENIED
properties.summary:
A [contactsAuthorization](api:Titanium.Contacts#contactsAuthorization) value
indicating that the application is not authorized to use the address book.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_UNKNOWN
properties.summary:
A [contactsAuthorization](api:Titanium.Contacts#contactsAuthorization) value
indicating that the authorization state is unknown.

properties.name: CONTACTS_KIND_ORGANIZATION
properties.summary: Specifies that a contact is an organization.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.Contacts.Person.kind](api:Titanium.Contacts.Person#kind) property.

One of the group of contact "kind" constants
[CONTACTS_KIND_ORGANIZATION](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_KIND_ORGANIZATION),
and [CONTACTS_KIND_PERSON](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_KIND_PERSON).

properties.name: CONTACTS_KIND_PERSON
properties.summary: Specifies that a contact is a person.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.Contacts.Person.kind](api:Titanium.Contacts.Person#kind) property.
One of the group of contact "kind" constants [CONTACTS_KIND_ORGANIZATION](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_KIND_ORGANIZATION), and [CONTACTS_KIND_PERSON](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_KIND_PERSON).

properties.name: CONTACTS_SORT_FIRST_NAME
properties.summary: Specifies that group members will be sorted by first name.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.Contacts.Group.sortedMembers](api:Titanium.Contacts.Group#sortedMembers) method.
One of the group of contact group "sort" constants [CONTACTS_SORT_FIRST_NAME](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_SORT_FIRST_NAME), and [CONTACTS_SORT_LAST_NAME](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_SORT_LAST_NAME).

properties.name: CONTACTS_SORT_LAST_NAME
properties.summary: Specifies that group members will be sorted by last name.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.Contacts.Group.sortedMembers](api:Titanium.Contacts.Group#sortedMembers) method.
One of the group of contact group "sort" constants [CONTACTS_SORT_FIRST_NAME](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_SORT_FIRST_NAME), and [CONTACTS_SORT_LAST_NAME](api:Titanium.Contacts#CONTACTS_SORT_LAST_NAME).

properties.name: contactsAuthorization
properties.summary: Returns an authorization constant indicating if the application has access to the address book.
properties.description:
Always returns `AUTHORIZATION_AUTHORIZED` on iOS pre-6.0 and Android devices.

If `contactsAuthorization` is `AUTHORIZATION_RESTRICTED`, you should not
attempt to re-authorize: this will lead to issues.

properties.name: includeNote
properties.summary: A boolean value that indicates whether to fetch the notes stored in contacts or not.
properties.description:
This  property need to be set before calling contacts APIs.
From iOS 13 or later if your app fetch note field from contact, the app must have to set key 'com.apple.developer.contacts.notes' to 'true' in entitlements section of tiapp.xml.

``` xml
<key>com.apple.developer.contacts.notes</key>
<true/>
```

See more details at https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/entitlements/com_apple_developer_contacts_notes and https://developer.apple.com/contact/request/contact-note-field.

methods.name: removePerson
methods.summary: Removes a contact from the address book.
methods.description:
On iOS:

This method must be followed by a save action to commit the data to the underlying database,
which can be done explicitly using [Titanium.Contacts.save](api:Titanium.Contacts#save) or implicitly using
[Titanium.Contacts.createPerson](api:Titanium.Contacts#createPerson). Although the [Titanium.Contacts.Person](api:Titanium.Contacts.Person) object will still
exist once committed, it will no longer be valid. Continuing to use it will result in
unpredictable behavior, including crashes.

On Android:

This method will remove the person from the Contacts book automatically.

methods.name: requestContactsPermissions
methods.description:
On Android, the request view will show if the permission is not accepted by the user, and the user did
not check the box "Never ask again" when denying the request. If the user checks the box "Never ask again,"
the user has to manually enable the permission in device settings.

This method requests `Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS` and `Manifest.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS` on Android.
If you require other permissions, you can also use [Titanium.Android.requestPermissions](api:Titanium.Android#requestPermissions).

In iOS 6, Apple introduced the Info.plist key `NSContactsUsageDescription` that is used to display an
own description while authorizing contacts permissions. In iOS 10, this key is mandatory and the application
will crash if your app does not include the key. Check the [Apple docs](https://developer.apple.com/library/content/documentation/General/Reference/InfoPlistKeyReference/Articles/CocoaKeys.html) for more information.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary:
Function to call upon user decision to grant contacts access.
Optional on SDK 10, as this method will return a `Promise`, which may be used to handle the result.

returns.summary: On SDK 10+, this method will return a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.

methods.name: save
methods.summary: Commits all pending changes to the underlying contacts database.
methods.description:
On Android:

Takes an array of [Titanium.Contacts.Person](api:Titanium.Contacts.Person) objects and saves changes for
the specified contacts only.

parameters.name: contacts
parameters.summary: List of contacts to save. Used on Android only.

parameters.summary: Argument containing parameters for this method. Optional on Android.

inlined.summary: Dictionary of options for the [Titanium.Contacts.showContacts](api:Titanium.Contacts#showContacts) method.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Determines whether to animate the show/hide of the contacts picker (iPhone, iPad only.)

properties.name: cancel
properties.summary: Function to call when selection is canceled.

properties.name: fields
properties.summary: Field names to show when selecting properties. By default, shows all available.

properties.name: selectedPerson
properties.summary: Function to call when a person is selected. Must not be used with `selectedProperty` property.

properties.name: selectedProperty
properties.summary:
Function to call when a property is selected. Must not be used with `selectedPerson`
property.
Note: If ringtone or texttone is selected, null values are returned, since these are unsupported
by Apple.
Since iOS 9.0, there is a native apple issue whereby it may return null if the birthday property
is selected on certain device models.
The callback contains the selected property and a 'person' object of type [Titanium.Contacts.Person](api:Titanium.Contacts.Person).
Since iOS 9.0, apple only returns the person object with partial information. Currently it is known to
at least contain the selected property and fullName.

events.name: reload
events.summary: Fired when the database backing the contacts module is modified externally.
events.description:
If you have an existing reference to a `Person` or `Group` object, you should obtain
a new reference from the `Contacts` module. Using the existing object may result
in unpredictable behavior, such as updating the wrong contact.
